clusters.title: The SwitchBot Smart Lock Ultra with Keypad is at its all-time low of $125.99

xda.author: XDA Deals Desk
xda.body:
The SwitchBot Smart Lock Ultra with Keypad is at its all-time low of $125.99
Smart locks with fingerprint readers have been a mid-price premium tier for a while, and most of the options in that range either skip the keypad, skip the app, or require a hub that adds another $30 to the bill.
